description: The business's locations (config). list them; add one (next ordinal allocated); update one's label/city/name or provider id. The ordinal is the identifier everywhere; #1 (main) is always the default.

ordinal.description: For update: which location (list shows ordinals). Never changes; description around it does.

square_location_id.description: Square location id captured at connect time — webhook sales resolve to this location's ordinal.

stripe_account_suffix.description: Stripe mapping hook (unused until Stripe carries a location signal).

paypal_merchant_id.description: PayPal mapping hook (unused until PayPal carries a location signal).
